payload.goal: Adopt the shape of TypeSafe Jev / System One models in sofar: typed judgements (noul, choice, score) over record state with calibrated probabilities and confidence-gated escalation, behind a Judge seam whose default is deterministic and whose model provider is explicit opt-in. Parked until TypeSafe releases Jev to the public (waitlist as of 2026-09-19); resume from the roadmap-h2 audit note 01M2X0KK6MT2AE2A83KWJ3PZX9. No tasks or phases until then.

payload.text:
Waitlist answer submitted to TypeSafe (console.typesafe.ai) on 2026-09-19, question "What would you try TypeSafe on first?":

"I build sofar, a work-memory tool for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) that keeps an append-only record of an initiative's plan, decisions and sessions, and drives agents through the task queue unattended. Today it decides things like 'did that session actually make progress?' and 'which of these 200 past decisions matter for the next task?' with counts and keyword rules. I'd point Jev at those judgements first: scoring what to inject into an agent's context, and catching when a new decision quietly re-proposes something already rejected."

Resume conditions: Jev public (no waitlist) or early-access granted; a published calibration curve or paper would change the ruling's risk column. Full audit, decision points, honest multipliers and the invariant conflict (SPEC Architectural invariants, felt-cost D3) live in roadmap-h2 note 01M2X0KK6MT2AE2A83KWJ3PZX9. First step on resume: rule on the Judge seam and log the opt-in Decision BEFORE any provider code; the deterministic default and the question set need no ruling.

payload.next_action: Wait for TypeSafe to open Jev publicly (or grant early access); then rule on the Judge seam and log the opt-in Decision before any provider code.
payload.summary: Created typed-judge as a parked initiative (no tasks, no phases, not bound) holding the Jev/System One thread; waitlist answer and resume conditions in note 01M2X219WX3Y7RKWE3Q31MB5MW; audit in roadmap-h2 note 01M2X0KK6MT2AE2A83KWJ3PZX9.
